use_case: AI Assist: generative case summaries, reply drafts, and knowledge article drafts in the Operations Cloud
vendor_or_model: Three contracted generative AI model providers (one per feature) through the AI Assist orchestration service; company-built prompts, retrieval, and checks
data_categories: Case text and history, knowledge articles of the same tenant; end-consumer personal information in case text
consequential_decision_category: None directly (drafts for customers' agents); becomes consequential if customers use outputs in decisions on financial services, health care, or similar
human_in_the_loop: Customer agent reviews, edits, and sends every reply; summaries labeled AI-generated; agent can regenerate or discard
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01); customer DPA and CCPA service provider terms (N51-R03); Utah AI Policy Act disclosure on request (customer-side, where applicable); Colo. SB26-189 developer duties (effective 2027-01-01) if used in consequential decisions
status: In production (generally available to about 2,300 customers)
customer_facing: Yes (customers' agents; consumers receive the replies)
bias_testing_status: Quality by consumer language tested (gap found); no protected attributes in inputs
monitoring: Monthly groundedness sample; quarterly language-quality review; injection test suite each release

use_case: AI Assist agent actions: model proposes account actions (credits, refunds, plan changes, case closure) that an agent confirms with one click
vendor_or_model: Same model providers as AI-001; company-built tool layer
data_categories: Case and account data of the same tenant
consequential_decision_category: Financial services when banking customers use it for fees or credits; otherwise none
human_in_the_loop: Agent must confirm each action; actions above a customer-set limit need a supervisor
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01); customer DPA and CCPA service provider terms (N51-R03); Colo. SB26-189 developer duties (effective 2027-01-01); CPPA ADMT rules, Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, 7200 (customer-side, by 2027-01-01)
status: Pilot (24 customers; non-financial actions only since 2026-08-19)
council_review: Not reviewed (review due 2026-11-30; required before general availability)
monitoring: Action override rate; injection test results

use_case: Case routing and priority suggestions (machine learning) in the Operations Cloud
vendor_or_model: Company-built model trained per tenant on that tenant's history
data_categories: Case metadata, language, channel, customer tier
consequential_decision_category: None directly; affects service speed for consumers
human_in_the_loop: Customers configure routing rules; suggestions only; supervisors can override
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01); customer DPA and CCPA service provider terms (N51-R03)
bias_testing_status: Fairness by consumer language and region planned (R-044)

use_case: Field service schedule optimization: assigns jobs to customers' technicians
